as_told.title: Host's Peru documentary on three-fingered mummies

plain: In Peru there are said to be mummified beings with three fingers and three toes. The podcaster Joe Rogan mentions them in passing to Michels as a recent find. Michels goes further: he says he has seen these skeletons himself, that he made a documentary about them, and that they date from 800 to 1,700 years ago. If they are what the tellers suggest, they would be the remains of beings that are not ordinary humans.
